name: Schiebepuzzle
tagline: Schiebe die Plättchen durch die Lücke wieder in die richtige Reihenfolge.
description: Spiele das Schiebepuzzle kostenlos: nummerierte Plättchen ordnen auf 3 × 3, 4 × 4 oder 5 × 5. Schlag deine Bestzeit oder spiele online gegen Freunde.
about: The 15 Puzzle is the classic sliding puzzle: fifteen numbered tiles in a 4 × 4 frame, with one empty space. Slide tiles into the gap until they read 1 to 15 in order, row by row, with the gap in the bottom-right corner. It became a craze in the 1880s and has been on desks and in pockets ever since.

Here you can also play the quicker 3 × 3 version, with eight tiles, or the much harder 5 × 5, with twenty-four. Every shuffle is made by sliding tiles at random from the solved position, so every puzzle can be solved. The clock and the move counter run from your first slide.
Play alone to beat your best time for each size, or race friends online: everyone gets the same shuffle, and the first to finish wins.
howToPlay: Choose a size to start. The clock starts with the puzzle.
Tap a tile next to the gap to slide it in. Tap a tile further along the same row or column to slide the whole line at once.
Tiles already in their final place are highlighted.
Put the tiles in order from 1, left to right and top to bottom, with the gap last.
Your time and moves are shown when you finish, and your best time for each size is kept.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a tile in the gap's row or column.
Mouse: click a tile in the gap's row or column.
Keyboard: move between tiles with the arrow keys and press Enter or Space to slide the focused one.
Pause or start a new puzzle from the bar above the game.
tips: Solve the top row first, then the left column. What's left is a smaller puzzle of the same kind.
Place the last two tiles of a row together: bring them into position as a pair rather than one by one.
Don't undo finished rows. You can almost always work in the rest of the frame.
On 5 × 5, the same plan works: two rows and two columns, and you're left with a 3 × 3.
Speed comes from planning a few slides ahead, not from tapping fast.

faq.question: Is the 15 Puzzle free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Can every puzzle be solved?
faq.answer: Yes. Each start is made by sliding tiles at random from the finished picture, so a way back always exists.

faq.question: Can I slide more than one tile?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap any tile in the gap's row or column, and every tile between it and the gap moves with it.

faq.question: How do races work?
faq.answer: Everyone in the room gets the same shuffle at the same moment, and the first to finish wins.
